D.kuro: o6 "GBufferD": x ToonRimWidth, y packed nibble, z 0, w packed AO|FFT

input_kinds.texture: Texture2D material parameter `param` (Texture Object pin); `default` = parent Material default texture
input_kinds.sampler: sampler paired with `texture`; ue_expr is the HLSL name inside the Custom node
input_kinds.scalar|vector: material parameter `param` (Kuro name), `default` = compiled/Material default; vector `channels` used
input_kinds.worldnormal|worldtangent: raw interpolated TangentToWorld rows (`channel` sign/bitangent), ue_expr given
input_kinds.interpolator: value produced in the VS by `source` (vertex_interpolators)
input_kinds.cpd: CustomPrimitiveData `index` (list = assembled vector), filled by UWuwaToonCharacterComponent
input_kinds.mpc: Material Parameter Collection `mpc` / `mpc_param` (Kuro asset default in `default`)
input_kinds.toonlight: ToonShadowLightData CB1 row `index` (float4); no recovered default (see note on [1].w bits)
input_kinds.view: View uniform field (ue_expr) or Kuro-only View member (ue_expr null, `kuro` row, explicit default)
input_kinds.primitive: Primitive data (ue_expr) or Kuro-only Primitive member (ue_expr null, explicit default)
input_kinds.output: out parameter, exposed as an additional Custom node output
input_kinds.uniform_expression: CPU uniform expression of material parameters `params` (`expr`, as UE material nodes in `ue_nodes`): evaluate on the CPU in float32 like a UE preshader, not in the Custom node
